# has EXIF tag

Relates a media object to one of its reified EXIF tags. Non-functional: an image carries many tags. Projects to schema:exifData.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasExifTag>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:hasExifTag`  

**Type:** `owl:ObjectProperty`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/images>
